typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

to.description: The {@link FailureModeLineItem} related to by this relation.

fromName.description: The name of the entity in the from field. Should be implemented as a stored calc in any type extending this type.

userRecommended.description:
If true, the {@link FailureModeLineItem} is recommended by user.
Otherwise, it is recommended by the failure mode reommendation engine.

latestFeedback.description: Most recent feedback for the failure mode

significance.description: How significant the {@link FailureModeLineItem} is to the {@link FailureModeRelation#fromName} instance.

displaySignificance.description: Displayed text of significance field. Round to 2 decimal precision.

feedbackIcon.description:
Only used to show the icon on the UI.
Ranges from -1 to 2.
-1: no feedback
0: bad
1: so-so
2: good

latestFeedbackText.description: Text of latest feedback to be displayed in UI. 0 - "Not Helpful", 2 - "Helpful"

title: Type that allows us to go from an entity (most commonly, alert or case) to the {@link FailureModeLineItem}s associated with it.
name: FailureModeRelation
